newsitem.title: CANADA: Costa Rica rejects Mineral Rayrock plan.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica rejects Mineral Rayrock plan.

text.p: Minera Rayrock Inc said on Friday that the Costa Rican government had not approved its environmental impact statement for the Bellavista gold project.
The company said it was pursuing an appeal.
It said it was disappointed with the decision "as we believe that we worked closely with the Costa Rican government and addressed all its concerns."
Minera Rayrock said it was studying its options, which might include resubmitting its statement if there was government support for a modified project, taking legal action or suspending the project.
